record.edic_text:
5558 chrusoo {khroo-so'-o}

from 5557;; v

AV - deck 2; 2

1) to adorn with gold, to gild
   1a) of a woman ornamented with gold so profusely that she seems to
       be gilded

same.cexp: 黃金；金幣，金錢；金飾，（貴重的）珠寶
橄欖石，黃璧璽（最貴重的一種）（#啟 21:20|）
用黃金遮蓋或裝飾，戴滿了金飾
